title: Coffee, Iced Cafe Mocha, decaffeinated, with non-dairy milk

content.title: About
content.content: Iced Cafe Mocha is a cold beverage made from decaffeinated espresso, chocolate syrup, and non‑dairy milk. It combines the rich flavor of coffee, the sweetness of cocoa, and the creamy texture of plant‑based milk, making it a popular choice for those avoiding caffeine and dairy.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeinated espresso is produced by removing caffeine from regular beans while preserving most flavor compounds.
The Mocha variation originated in the early 1900s in San Francisco, where coffee was blended with chocolate.
Plant‑based milks (oat, almond, soy) are frequently used in cold coffee drinks for their light texture and neutral taste.
Cold coffee drinks help lower body temperature in hot weather while still providing a refreshing lift.
Chocolate syrup is often made from natural cocoa, sugar, and vanilla, without artificial flavors.

items.title: Reduced nervous system stimulation
items.content: The lack of caffeine lowers the risk of anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heart rate, especially for sensitive individuals.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Chocolate syrup contains flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health and improve mood.

items.title: Benefits of non‑dairy milk
items.content: Oat and soy milks are rich in B‑vitamins, vitamin D, and often calcium, contributing to bone health.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Being mostly water, the drink helps maintain proper hydration.

items.title: Low sugar potential (when made modestly)
items.content: Using unsweetened or lightly sweetened syrup can make the beverage more diet‑friendly compared to typical dessert coffees.

items.title: Allergy to plant milk
items.content: Some individuals may react to soy, almond, or oat milk with allergic symptoms.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup often adds a significant amount of sugar, which can raise blood glucose levels.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Despite being caffeine‑free, the drink can be calorie‑rich due to milk and syrup.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Commercial versions may contain artificial flavors, preservatives, or emulsifiers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Iced Cafe Mocha in a tall glass over ice, garnish with whipped non‑dairy cream or a dusting of grated chocolate. A pinch of cinnamon or a dash of vanilla extract can add extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated and consume within 24 hours. Store unopened plant‑based milk according to the manufacturer’s instructions, typically refrigerated after opening. Keep chocolate syrup in a sealed bottle in a cool place.
